verdict.rationale: The only programmatic surface in the evidence is the official Thoropass MCP server. It covers a narrow slice of the UI: listing audits and evidence requests, viewing details and linked systems, and adding comments, attachments and status updates. The many UI features documented elsewhere (risk register, unified and custom controls, policies, access reviews, monitors, user and workspace administration) have no evidenced API or MCP equivalent. Missing for 10: a documented general-purpose public API, API or MCP coverage of risk register, controls, policies, access reviews, monitors and admin functions, any statement of UI/API parity, and independent corroboration.
